game.title: Star Wars Outlaws
game.blurb: Open-world Star Wars action-adventure from Massive Entertainment (Ubisoft), released 2024-08-30. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours (far under a full run). Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Kay Vess and Nix plan one big score, planet by planet. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Syndicates, Wanted and Contracts
chapters.summary: Reputation with the four syndicates, Wanted levels, contracts, Intel chains and Expert quests.

chapters.title: Activities and Exploration
chapters.summary: Sabacc, fathier races, arcade games, street food, Nix treasures, gear sets and every planet area.

chapters.title: Ships and Speeder
chapters.summary: Space combat, the Trailblazer, the Kijimi nebula and speeder tricks.

chapters.title: Combat, Stealth and Slicing
chapters.summary: Adrenaline Rush, Nix attacks, Fast-Talk, slicing, lockpicking and blaster upgrades.

chapters.title: Story Packs
chapters.summary: Achievements added after launch, likely from the two story add-ons.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Star Wars Outlaws" or "Star Wars: Outlaws". starwars.fandom.com (Wookieepedia) answers the API, with 500 linked pages (the API limit, so likely more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Project_xyz" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2842040. None of the 59 Steam achievements are hidden, so story beats are visible; the main story chapter is spoiler-guarded. The last 10 achievements in the schema (the Morenia, Aksali Noll, Okala V, the Khepi, Rokana Raiders, Refractor, the pirate poem) look like post-launch story content and sit in their own chapter; which add-on each belongs to was not checked. RAWG playtime is far below a real run.
